verdict.rationale: Tavily has a public, self-serve pricing page built on API credits. It offers 1,000 free credits per month with no credit card required and a 'pay only for what you use' model, so a developer can start without contacting sales. However, the evidence never shows a dollar price per credit or how many credits each request type (search, extract, crawl, research) consumes. That leaves the 'clear per-request/per-credit pricing' core of the story unproven. Missing for 10: explicit per-credit dollar rates, per-endpoint credit costs, paid-tier price points, independent confirmation that pricing is fully transparent.
